hidden_resolution.root_cause: Response caching layer retains request objects indefinitely

contradictions.claim_a: Garbage collection is healthy and keeps up with the allocation rate
contradictions.claim_b: Garbage collection is misconfigured and causes the memory growth
contradictions.resolution: The heap dump shows the retained objects are reachable from the cache; GC has nothing to collect

hidden_resolution.decision: Disable the response caching layer and add a TTL with an eviction policy for cached entries

hidden_resolution.primary_hypothesis: Schema migration broke the reconciliation job

contradictions.claim_a: The reconciliation job is idempotent and stable
contradictions.claim_b: The reconciliation job failed after the deploy
contradictions.resolution: The stability documentation at 10:00 was stale; migration 004 at 12:00 renamed the column the job's SQL reads

hidden_resolution.root_cause: Load balancer health check probes the old port after the service moved
hidden_resolution.primary_hypothesis: Stale health-check port in load balancer config

contradictions.claim_a: The service is unhealthy because the health check fails
contradictions.claim_b: The service is healthy on the new port
contradictions.resolution: The probe targets the old port 8080; the endpoint moved to 9090 in release r310, so the failures are false negatives

hidden_resolution.decision: Update the staging load balancer health check to probe /api/health on port 9090 and pause the auto-rollback loop until the probe is fixed
